title: Corporate AI training for manufacturing
meta_title: AI training for manufacturing companies | Artificia AI
meta_description: Corporate AI training for manufacturing companies in Gujarat. Tenders, quotations, quality reports and MIS, built from your own documents. Free 1-hour pilot.

fields.statement: AI for quotations, reports and plant documents.
fields.after_text: Plant teams using AI every day.
fields.subheading: Tenders, quotations, quality reports and dispatch updates take hours of copying. We train your teams to hand that work to AI, using your own documents.

fields.heading: Where a factory *loses hours*
fields.intro: Three jobs, before and after training.

items.title: Tenders and RFPs
items.before: Requirements read by hand, and each response rebuilt from old files.
items.after: Requirements become a checklist, and a first response is drafted from past submissions.

items.title: Quotations
items.before: Each quote typed line by line from the rate card.
items.after: The scope becomes an itemised quote from your rate card and templates.

items.title: Monthly MIS
items.before: The same report takes someone most of a day, every month.
items.after: The report is assembled from your sheets, ready for a manager to check.

fields.heading: Teams that *join* the program
fields.intro: Each department works on its own tasks in the same program.

cards.title: Sales

fields.heading: How a plant program *starts*
fields.intro: Length and format are set by your needs and your shifts.

steps.title: Find where work waits
steps.text: We meet department heads and trace where work waits or gets re-typed.

steps.title: Use your own files
steps.text: Exercises use your quotations, rate cards, reports and tender documents.

steps.title: Build in every session
steps.text: Each session ends with a working prompt, workflow or tool your team keeps.

steps.title: Agree the data rules
steps.text: Before training starts, we agree in writing what may never be uploaded.

items.question: Can you train shift staff without stopping production?
items.answer: Yes. Sessions are scheduled around your shifts, on-site or online, so production keeps running.

items.question: Our files include drawings and costings. Are they safe?
items.answer: Your drawings, costings and customer data stay yours. We agree upload rules in writing, use approved tools only, and train staff to check AI output.

items.question: Do you cover tenders and quotations?
items.answer: Yes. Teams learn to turn tenders into checklists, draft responses from past submissions, and build quotes from their own rate cards.

items.question: Does it work with Tally or our ERP?
items.answer: Training covers working with the reports and sheets your systems export. Connecting AI directly to an ERP is a build project our services team handles.

fields.heading: Ask for a *free pilot*
fields.intro: Tell us about your plant and teams. We will set up a free 1-hour AI consultation and walkthrough to review how your team works and identify where AI can improve productivity and save time.

side_points.text: On-site, or online over Microsoft Teams
